verdict.rationale: ReadMe's Agent drafts and edits content across Guides, API References and Custom Pages from a chat prompt or inline instructions. The GitHub AI Writer watches pull requests and proposes doc updates when code changes. AI Linter, Docs Audit and Reviews check pages against natural-language rules, and Branches and Reviews keep changes out of the live hub until approved. Missing for 10: no evidence of schedule-triggered agent runs, no explicit documentation that agent output is packaged as a change request or branch (only implied), and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
